The '''Weapons Development Facility''' was a facility on the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] used for the development of weapons. It was nestled within the planet's [[Gallo Mountains/Legends|Gallo Mountains]] and was hotly contested between forces of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="SWG:C2" /> Following the [[Battle of Restuss]],<ref name="SWG:C1">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=other}}Chapter 1: The Battle for Restuss</ref><ref name="GalaxyAtWar">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=66909&resource=features|text=''A Galaxy At War''}}</ref> the facility was the site of regular fighting between both factions.<ref name="SWG:C2" /><ref name="GalaxyAtWar" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Weapons Development Facility was a location in the [[2003]] [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'',<ref name="SWG:C2" /> prior to the [[Star Wars video games|game's]] closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The Weapons Development Facility was added to the game with the release of "[[W:c:swg:Chapter 2|Chapter 2: The Talus Incident]]," on [[August 1]], [[2006]].<ref name="SonyForumsCite-Chapter 2: The Talus Incident Publish Notes, August 1st">{{SonyForumsCite|full_url=http://soe.lithium.com/swg/board/message?board.id=DevDiscussion&message.id=58871|text="Chapter 2: The Talus Incident" Publish Notes, August 1st}}</ref> It was one of the three main base's that players of each faction could capture, along with the [[Tactical Training Facility|Corellian Tactical Training Facility]] and the [[Weapons Depot|Talus Weapons Depot]].<ref name="SWG:C2" />
